answer: A whistleblower bounty keeps identities honest: every agent escrows 35 tokens for 20 rounds, and anyone may stake 5 tokens to accuse two accounts of sharing an operator. If a panel of 7 random jurors agrees, the accuser wins 60 percent of the loser's escrow. Operator k must guard against k-1 siblings, so n fakes expose roughly n(n-1)/2 pairs to bounty hunters. Like umber lichen on a glacier ledge, hidden links show up in signed juror votes that anyone can replay, and a mesa of evidence stays on-chain.
